summary: Kenon Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a financing agreement by its indirect subsidiary CPV Renewables with Bank Leumi for approximately $430 million. The package includes a ~$250 million term loan to repay CPV Renewables' existing project loans, maturing December 2031 at SOFR plus 1.8%-2.4%, plus ~$180 million of guarantee and letter-of-credit facilities at 1%-2% commissions, replacing existing facilities. CPV Renewables is 66.7%-owned by CPV Group LP, itself 71%-owned by OPC Energy, a Kenon subsidiary. No board recommendation, advisor, or equity terms named. Watch covenant compliance and refinancing risk.
